kpi.rulesTitle: How KPIs and the transaction table are calculated:
kpi.rulesKpi: • KPI: Calculated from successfully paid orders (PAID) and filtered by the actual payment time (paidAt).
kpi.rulesTable: • Order table: Filtered by order creation time (createdAt).
kpi.rulesNote: Therefore, if an order is created late on one day and paid the next day, the KPI figures and the number of order rows under the same date filter may differ.
